alignments.note: Construct noun with no article morpheme present takes the supplied the (rule 29).
The relative is rendered wherein; bo below keeps its own in him, so nothing is fused here.
Article takes the the written before its own word (rule 15).
Verbless clause with a prepositional predicate takes the supplied copula on the preposition and heads on it (rule 49).
Pronominal suffix takes the object pronoun (rule 18).
Inflected verb takes the subject pronoun and auxiliaries with the lexical predicate (rules 17, 24).
Explicit pronoun subject takes only its own English (rule 20).
Adverbial accusative rendered alone; unit discontinuous from its verb (rule 25).
Inflected verb takes the subject pronoun and auxiliary with the lexical verb (rule 17).

min plus huts is rendered by the single English word without, so the two fuse and head on the lexeme word (rule 30). The clause moshavo mi-huts la-mmahaneh is verbless with a prepositional predicate, so the supplied copula shall ... be joins the preposition heading that phrase (rules 20, 49); the unit is discontinuous around the fronted subject (rule 25). The competing reading, taken by the previous alignment, put shall ... be on moshav, but moshavo is the clause's explicit subject and rule 20 leaves an explicit subject only its own English.
The ASV spends no word on this lamed (rule 40).
Assimilated article is a real token and takes the ASV's the (rule 12).
The clause's explicit subject takes only its own English noun (rule 20).
Pronominal suffix takes the possessive pronoun (rule 18).

review_notes: Corrected: the supplied copula of the final clause moved from moshav to the fused mi-huts unit. moshavo is the subject and mi-huts la-mmahaneh the prepositional predicate, so rule 49 (and rule 20's ruling that an explicit subject takes only its own English) puts shall ... be on the preposition; the verse already reads 'asher ha-nega' bo this way at is in.
min plus huts still fuses in without under rule 30, and the fused unit is now discontinuous around the fronted subject (rule 25).
